title: The Noise Premium in Adversarial Training for Kernel Regression
abstract: arXiv:2607.27995v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Adversarial training can improve the robustness of predictive models to bounded perturbations, often at the cost of statistical efficiency. We study this trade-off in kernel regression over a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). It is shown that, under squared loss, adversarial training in RKHS introduces a term involving the product of the function norm with the mean absolute value of the response noise, which we call the \textit{noise premium}. Our analysis shows that the noise premium makes the prediction error of adversarial training converge strictly more slowly than the nonparametric minimax benchmark even after balancing approximation and estimation errors. Moreover, for a fixed perturbation budget, once the budget exceeds a certain threshold, the solution to adversarial training collapses to the zero function. translated_title: 核回归对抗训练中的噪声溢价
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2607.27995v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：对抗训练可以提高预测模型对有界扰动的鲁棒性，但通常以统计效率为代价。我们研究了在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中核回归的这种权衡。研究表明，在平方损失下，RKHS中的对抗训练引入了一个涉及函数范数与响应噪声平均绝对值乘积的项，我们称之为“噪声溢价”。我们的分析表明，即使在平衡逼近误差和估计误差之后，噪声溢价也会使对抗训练的预测误差收敛速度严格慢于非参数极小极大基准。此外，对于固定的扰动预算，一旦预算超过某个阈值，对抗训练的解会退化为零函数。为了减轻噪声溢价的影响，我们提出了去偏对抗训练。结果……
tldr: 本文揭示了核回归对抗训练中“噪声溢价”导致收敛速度慢于最优基准，并提出了去偏对抗训练来缓解此问题。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that a "noise premium" in adversarial training for kernel regression causes slower convergence than the optimal benchmark, and proposes noise-debiased adversarial training to mitigate it.
